latest_published_release.name: v0.5.0
latest_published_release.body:
- Added cross-platform bootstrap installers that create/update a durable local
  runtime at `~/.jev-mcp/runtime` instead of relying on npm Git-package
  execution at every MCP startup.
- Stable bootstrap installs now default to the `v0.5.0` tag; advanced users can
  set `JEV_MCP_GIT_REF=main` to follow the development channel.
- Added one-command setup for Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, ZCode, Cursor,
  Gemini CLI, Windsurf-compatible config, generic `.agents`, and
  project-scoped VS Code MCP configuration.
- Added a user-level `~/.jev-mcp/.env` credential store so GUI clients do not
  need API keys embedded in MCP configuration.
- Added safe JSON config merging with local backups and absolute local
  Node/runtime launch paths.
- Added installer unit tests, Linux/Windows bootstrap smoke checks, CLI smoke
  checks, and dedicated client/install documentation.

- Redesigned the English and Chinese project homepages around quick onboarding,
  tool boundaries, privacy, and a clear host-model/Jev authority model.
- Added quick-start, FAQ, troubleshooting, examples, support, governance,
  roadmap, and CODEOWNERS documentation.
- Added Markdown/repository consistency checks and strengthened secret/privacy
  scanning to catch common credential patterns and accidental local home paths.
- Upgraded first-party GitHub Actions used by CI/release workflows to current
  major versions.
- Added a CI-generated npm lockfile and switched CI, release, setup, and
  publishing flows to reproducible `npm ci` installs.
- Added safer issue routing and a structured usage-question template to reduce
  accidental disclosure of secrets or sensitive project data.

latest_published_release.name: ModelDock 0.2.0 — Large-file preview and model comparison
latest_published_release.body:
ModelDock lets you open reconstruction models and CAD files directly in an editor or supported desktop host. This release adds bounded large-file previews and a shared model-comparison workflow.

## 新增功能

- 四个入口默认允许最高 8 GiB 的源文件：VS Code、DeepSeek Harness、兼容的 OpenAI Desktop 文件入口、独立本地查看器。
- 超过 5 GiB 的二进制 PLY/STL 使用有界分段读取：PLY 最多显示 30 万个采样点，STL 最多显示 10 万个采样三角面；保留原始数量、坐标原点及采样说明。
- 多模型工作流：添加模型 → 选择参考/真值 → 按需对齐 → 比较。支持多 PLY 叠加、同步分屏、透明度、局部刚性 ICP、显式平移/旋转/缩放和重置。
- 可导入 STL 网格作为参考真值，计算双向距离统计、RMSE、P95、采样最大值、Chamfer、精确率、召回率和 F-score；支持误差热图、逐个对参考评价，以及 JSON/CSV 导出。
- 自动刷新保留视角、其他模型、参考选择及变换；中英文界面。

## 安装包

发布工作流会自动附加以下文件：

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| modeldock-0.2.0.vsix | VS Code：扩展菜单 → 从 VSIX 安装；也适用于在 VS Code 中使用 Codex 的工作流 |
| dsh-plugin-modeldock-0.2.0.tgz | DeepSeek Harness 原生文件预览插件 |
| modeldock-openai-0.2.0.zip | 支持文件入口及授权资源读取的 OpenAI Desktop 插件 |
| modeldock-0.2.0-source.zip | 完整源码、预构建运行文件、安装包、许可及匹配的 CAD 依赖源码 |
| SHA256SUMS.txt | 四个归档的 SHA-256 校验值 |

使用说明：[中文 README](https://github.com/Afloat16/modeldock/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) · [Harness 安装](https://github.com/Afloat16/modeldock/blob/main/adapters/deepseek-harness/README.md) · [OpenAI Desktop 安装](https://github.com/Afloat16/modeldock/blob/main/docs/openai-integration.md)。

## 验证与边界

- 105 项自动测试；共享浏览器 15 组、对比界面 9 组、OpenAI 旧资源路径 7 组、大文件范围路径 6 组，另有真实 stdio 验证。
- 真实安装的 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-alpha.2 Web 通过 8 组检查，包括超过 5 GiB 的 PLY/STL；真实 VS Code 1.96.4 已在 GitHub CI 中通过四阶段原生验收，包括这两种大文件。
- 大文件用例使用真实稀疏文件，验证大小、偏移、范围读取和渲染，不代表密集 5 GiB 数据的吞吐性能基准。
- 5 GiB 能力是二进制 PLY/STL 的采样预览；大型 PLY 网格当前仅显示采样顶点，面拓扑会明确标为省略。其他格式保持 128 MiB 普通解析边界；不支持完整 5 GiB STEP/IGES/BREP 转换。
- 比较指标描述加载/采样后的几何，最大值不是精确 Hausdorff 距离；单位必须确认，ICP 不自动修正比例，也不保证全局配准。
- OpenAI 使用真实应用和 MCP 服务、模拟 Desktop 宿主进行验证；尚未完成专有 Desktop 软件的实际安装验收。CLI、Work Web 和移动端不声明原生 3D 文件入口能力。
- 发布前依赖扫描为 0 项已知漏洞；这不等于独立安全审计。

详见 [验证记录](https://github.com/Afloat16/modeldock/blob/main/docs/validation.md)。原始项目源码和原创样例采用 MIT；CAD 依赖保留自身 LGPL 许可，匹配源码随完整源码包提供。

最终发布提交：`2f93e45f0b47ee7f842abd9f86ddcc4e79983c4c`。[完整 CI 已通过](https://github.com/Afloat16/modeldock/actions/runs/40856160717)，包含浏览器流程、依赖审计和独立的 VS Code 原生任务。

default_branch_head.author: Afloat16
default_branch_head.message: Prioritize English and localize project navigation

latest_published_release.name: v0.2.0 - Email-first workflow instructions
latest_published_release.body:
## Email-first human input

Send the complete reviewed steps and an ordinary official login/action link in the email. There is no blanket requirement to return to GPT for every interaction.

- Optional canonical `action`: bounded numbered steps, ordinary reply prompt, and completion hint
- Explicit email-only action opt-in: `AAN_INCLUDE_ACTION=1` or `--include-action` in the producer
- Configured `AAN_SMTP_REPLY_TO`, exact transmitted Message-ID, request reference and current revision
- `aan replies ingest --file message.eml` and `aan replies list` for a durable unverified-input review inbox
- Current-request checks, replay/conflict protection, bounded MIME parsing, and obsolete-note handling
- Additive SQLite v1 → v2 migration, preserving existing event identities, pending requests, and queued deliveries
- Explicit database paths work without a home-directory profile

[English setup](https://github.com/Afloat16/agent-action-notifier/blob/v0.2.0/docs/email-first.md) · [中文设置指南](https://github.com/Afloat16/agent-action-notifier/blob/v0.2.0/docs/email-first.zh-CN.md)

## Important limits

Reply import is local and explicit. This release does not poll a mailbox, authenticate an email author, create an agent-answer channel, or configure SMTP/provider access. Imported replies always remain `pending_unverified` with `can_authorize: false`; they cannot approve, execute, resolve, or resume actions. A separately authorized host must establish owner intent and apply its original confirmation policy. Required platform confirmation forms still use their required surface. Passwords and sign-in credentials stay on the official service.

Defaults remain generic. Review action content before opting in: heuristic redaction cannot guarantee removal of private information. SMTP acceptance does not prove inbox delivery or human attention. No live SMTP/inbox/desktop end-to-end delivery was established.

## Upgrading

Back up your existing SQLite state using a consistent SQLite backup while producers/workers are stopped; do not copy only a live WAL-backed `.db` file. First use of 0.2.0 upgrades the database to schema v2. Version 0.1.0 cannot open that upgraded schema; downgrade requires your retained v1 backup. Nothing installs a background service or creates credentials.

## Downloads

Python 3.10+ is required. The `.pyz` runs without third-party runtime dependencies or package installation. The wheel and source archive are alternatives. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## 中文摘要

新版本可以将经审阅的完整操作步骤和官方登录/操作入口直接写进邮件，并提供普通问题的回复提示，不再要求每次都回到 GPT。需要在生产方明确启用邮件正文，并自行配置 SMTP 和回复邮箱。

本地 `.eml` 导入只生成“未经验证的待处理输入”，不会自动收邮件、确认身份、授权、执行或恢复任务。平台要求的确认表单仍须在指定界面完成；密码与登录凭据留在官方服务。升级会保留旧事件、请求和发送队列并迁移数据库，回退旧版本须使用提前保存的一致性备份。

## Verification

158 unique stdlib tests pass locally. The exact final commit `80a5cd2f881c5e7a62e03cfcf9dac2bb5780266b` passed all nine Linux/macOS/Windows × Python 3.10/3.12/3.14 CI jobs, including compilation and zipapp smoke. SMTP tests are mocked; webhook tests exercise real loopback HTTP. The zipapp, wheel, and source archive were checked byte-for-byte against committed Python source. [CI evidence](https://github.com/Afloat16/agent-action-notifier/actions/runs/37247755439).
